steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the required vendor-lock configuration before creating the event.
Set the required ceiling-price read-only configuration.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.
Choose the Buy pricing template requested by the case.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Verify that the All Vendors window opens.
Verify the vendor search field is present.
Verify the Filters button is present.
Verify the Cancel button is present.
Verify the Save button is present.
